customer_persona: Designed for urban professionals and families who want a confident compact SUV for city traffic and highway journeys. It suits drivers prioritizing verified crash safety, high road clearance, and modern cabin technology across petrol, diesel, and alternative fuel options.
decision_frame: The strongest supported fit is a family or commuter who values certified five-star crash protection, tall road clearance, and modern cabin screens; what remains to verify is your real-world fuel economy and preferred engine feel on an in-person test drive.
takeaway: The Tata Nexon gives you certified five-star crash protection and high ground clearance wrapped in a refined, tech-packed compact SUV.
primary_outcome: Complete peace of mind on Indian roads through certified five-star structural safety and standard stability protection.
supporting_outcomes: Effortless daily usability over poor roads with 208 mm of unladen ground clearance
Generous family luggage space with up to 382 litres of boot capacity

concerns.why: Buyers need assurance that their family is protected against unpredictable highway hazards and city traffic.
Waterlogged city streets, high speed breakers, and broken rural roads risk underbody scrapes.
Compact SUVs often compromise boot space, especially when opting for dual-cylinder gas configurations.
Buyers want to understand official fuel efficiency figures across petrol, diesel, and CNG engines before deciding.

usps.name: Standard certified five-star crash protection
usps.why_it_matters: Every passenger gets six airbags, stability control, and proven five-star impact protection without having to buy the top model.

usps.name: Class-commanding rough road clearance
usps.why_it_matters: A 208 mm stance lets you glide over deep potholes and flooded monsoon roads without worrying about underbody impacts.

usps.name: High-definition connected twin displays
usps.why_it_matters: A pair of crisp 10.25-inch screens brings turn-by-turn navigation, media, and 360-degree cameras directly into your line of sight.

intake.q1: Hello and welcome to Tata Motors! Would you like to share what kind of driving you have planned for your next SUV, or shall we simply jump straight into the tour?

state_questions.question: Would you prefer to focus first on passenger safety and daily comfort, or explore the different engine and gearbox options?
To help pinpoint the right transmission and trim, will this car spend most of its time in stop-and-go city traffic or out on open highways?
Since daily running cost and family comfort are top priorities, would you like to compare the boot space and pulling power between the petrol and dual-cylinder gas options?

do_not_recommend_if: Do not recommend if you require a full-time three-row vehicle for seven passengers or an authentic four-wheel-drive system for severe off-road terrain.
advance: Schedule an in-person test drive to experience the turbo engine pulling power and cabin visibility firsthand by clicking Book Test Drive.
notes: ARAI fuel efficiency numbers (U01), exact standard warranty terms (U02), and specific variant-level ex-showroom tiers above the base ₹7.39 Lakh model (U05) are omitted from the facts and must be handled transparently during dealership contact.
